en.headline: AFCD launches dual-use fishing boat pilot for leisure tours
en.dek: Two modified vessels will offer guided trips from Aberdeen where visitors can watch net hauling and learn about local fish species.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department held a launching ceremony at the Aberdeen Fish Market on Thursday for a pilot under the Fish + Joy scheme that allows fishing boats to carry passengers.

Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan and AFCD Director Leung Kin-ming officiated. Two vessels have been modified with fixed seating, life-saving equipment and other safety fittings after collaboration between AFCD and the Marine Department. The 24-metre boat can carry 30 passengers and the 15-metre boat can carry 14.

Guided tours are expected to operate in waters between Deep Water Bay and Lamma Island, letting participants observe net hauling, learn about common Hong Kong fish species and sample fresh catch on board. Fees are projected at around HK$500 to HK$600 per person. The project received support from the Sustainable Fisheries Development Fund.

Tse said the pilot extends the Fish + Joy concept, previously applied to fish farms, to fishing vessels that previously could only be used for fishing under Class III licences. The aim is to help the industry diversify while offering new leisure options for residents and visitors.

zh.headline: 漁護署推「漁＋樂」漁船計劃 示範船載客出海
zh.dek: 兩艘改裝漁船將於香港仔水域提供導賞團，讓市民近距離觀看起網及認識本地魚種。
body: 漁農自然護理署周四於香港仔魚類批發市場舉行「漁＋樂」漁船計劃示範項目開航禮，標誌休閒漁業擴展至漁船。
環境及生態局局長謝展寰及漁護署署長黎堅明主持儀式。兩艘示範漁船經漁護署與海事處協作完成改裝，加設固定座椅及救生設備等，符合安全規格。24米長的漁船可載30人，15米長的可載14人。
導賞團預計在深水灣至南丫島對開水域運作，參加者可觀看漁民起網收漁獲、認識香港常見魚種，並即場試食新鮮漁獲。收費預計每人約500至600元。項目獲漁業持續發展基金支持。
謝展寰表示，第III類別牌照漁船原本只可用作捕魚，不能載客。是次示範將「漁＋樂」理念由魚排及內陸魚場延伸至漁船，協助業界升級轉型，同時為市民及旅客提供更多海上休閒選擇。
